semiconductor_relevance: High — ElectraMet provides onsite reclamation solutions specifically designed for semiconductor wastewater, addressing critical environmental and sustainability challenges in the industry.
summary: ElectraMet specializes in designing and manufacturing advanced reclamation systems that effectively remove metal ions and hydrogen peroxide from semiconductor wastewater. Their technology supports sustainability initiatives by enabling onsite metal recovery and reducing the environmental impact of waste management.
capabilities: Metal recovery from microelectronics waste streams
Automation and analytics for operational efficiency
